verses: Aey logo! apney perwerdigar say daro, jiss ney tumhen aik jaan say peda kiya aur ussi say uss ki biwi ko peda kerkay unn dono say boht say mard aur aurten phela den, uss Allah say daro jiss kay naam per aik doosray say mangtay ho aur rishtay naatay toryney say bhi bacho bey shak Allah Taalaa tum per nigehbaan hai
Aur yateemon ko unn kay maal dey do aur pak aur halal cheez kay badlay pak aur haram cheez na lo, aur apney maalon kay sath unn kay maal mila ker kha na jao, bey shak yeh boht bara gunah hai

Agar tumhen darr ho kay yateem larkiyon say nikkah kerkay tum insaf na rakh sako gay to aur aurton mein say jo bhi tumhen achi lagen tum unn say nikkah ker lo, do do, teen teen, char char say, lekin agar tumhen barabari na ker sakney ka khof ho to aik hi kafi hai ya tumhari milkiyat ki londi yeh ziyadah qareeb hai, kay (aisa kerney say insafi aur) aik taraf jhuk parney say bach jao
Aur aurton ko unn kay mehar razi khushi dey do, haan agar woh khud apni khushi say kuch mehar chor den to ussay shoq say khush ho ker kha lo

Bey aqal logon ko apna maal na dey do jiss maal ko Allah Taalaa ney tumhari guzraan kay qaeem rakhney ka zariye banaya hai, haan unhen uss maal say khilao pilao, pehnao, orahao aur unhen maqooliyat say naram baat kaho

Aur yateemon ko unn kay baligh ho janey tak sidhartay aur aazmatay raho phir agar unn mein tum hoshiyari aur husn-o-khoobi tadbeer pao to unhen unn kay maal sonp do aur unn kay baray ho janey kay darr say unn kay maalon ko jaldi jaldi fazool kharchiyon mein tabah na ker do, maal daron ko chahaiye kay (unn kay maal say) bachtay rahen, haan miskeen mohtaj ho to dastoor kay mutabiq wajibi tor say kha ley, phir jab unhen unn kay maal sonpo to gawah bana lo, dar-asal hisab lenay wala Allah Taalaa hi kafi hai

Maa baap aur khwesh khawesh-o-aqarib kay tarkay mein mardon ka hissa bhi hai aur aurton ka bhi. (jo maal maa baap aur khwesh khawesh-o-aqarib chor maren) khuwah woh maal kum ho ya ziyadah (uss mein) hissa muqarrar kiya hua hai
Aur jab taqseem kay waqt qarabat daar aur yateem aur miskeen aajayen to tum uss mein say thora boht unhen bhi dey do aur unn say narmi say bolo

Aur chahaiye kay woh uss baat say daren kay agar woh khud apney peechay (nannhay nannhay) tawan bachay chor jatay jin kay zaya ho janey ka andesha rehta hai, (to unn ki chahat kiya hoti) pus Allah Taalaa say darr ker jachi tuli baat kaha keren
Jo log na-haq zulm say yateemon ka maal kha jatay hain, woh apney pet mein aag hi bhar rahey hain aur unqareeb woh dozakh mein jayen gay

Allah Taalaa tumhen tumhari aulad kay baray mein hukum kerta hai kay aik larkay ka hissa do larkiyon kay barabar hai aur agar sirf larkiyan hi hun aur do say ziyadah hun to unhen maal matrooka ka do tehaee milay ga. Aur agar aik hi larki ho to uss kay liye aadha hai aur mayyat kay maa baap mein say her aik kay liye uss kay choray huye maal ka chata hissa hai, agar uss (mayyat) ki aulad ho, aur agar aulad na ho aur maa baap waris hotay hun to uss ki maa kay liye teesra hissa hai, haan agar mayyat kay kaee bhai hun to phir uss ki maa ka chata hissa hai. Yeh hissay uss wasiyat (ki takmeel) kay baad hain jo marney wala ker gaya ho ya ada-e qarz kay baad, tumharay baap hun ya tumharay betay tumhen nahi maloom kay unn mein say kaun tumhen nafa pehchaney mein ziyadah qareeb hai, yeh hissay Allah Taalaa ki taraf say muqarrar kerdah hain bey shak Allah Taalaa pooray ilm aur kamil hikmaton wala hai

Tumhari biwiyan jo kuch chor maren aur unn ki aulad na ho to aadhon aadh tumhara hai aur agar unn ki aulad ho to unn kay choray huye maal mein say tumharay liye chothaee hissa hai. Uss wasiyat ki adaayegi kay baad jo woh ker gaee hun ya qarz kay baad. Aur jo (tarkay) tum chor jao uss mein unn kay liye chothaee hai, agar tumhari aulad na ho aur agar tumhari aulad ho to phir unhen tumharay tarkay ka aathwan hissa milay ga, uss wasiyat kay baad jo tum ker gaye ho aur qarz ki adaayegi kay baad. Aur jin ki meeras li jati hai woh mard ya aurat kalala ho yani uss ka baap beta na ho. Aur uss ka aik bhai ya aik behan ho to unn dono mein say her aik ka chata hissa hai aur uss say ziyadah hun to aik tehaee mein sab shareek hain, uss wasiyat kay baad jo ki jaye aur qarz kay baad jab kay auron ka nuksan na kiya gaya ho yeh muqarrar kiya hua Allah Taalaa ki taraf say hai aur Allah Taalaa dana hai burdbaar

Yeh hadden Allah Taalaa ki muqarrar ki hui hain aur jo Allah Taalaa ki aur uss kay rasool Allah) salla Allah alaihi wasallam (ki farmanbardari keray ga ussay Allah Taalaa jannaton mein ley jaye ga jin kay neechay nehren beh rahi hain jin mein woh hamesha rahen gay aur yeh boht bari kaamyabi hai

Aur jo shakhs Allah Taalaa ki aur uss kay rasool Allah) salla Allah alaihi wasallam (ki na-farmani keray aur uss ki muqarrara haddon say aagay niklay ussay woh jahannum mein daal dey ga jiss mein woh hamesha rahey ga, aison hi kay liye ruswa kun azab hai

Tumhari aurton mein say jo bey hayaee ka kaam keren unn per apney mein say char gawah talab kero, agar woh gawahi den to unn aurton ko gharon mein qaid rakho, yahan tak kay maut unn ki umaren poori kerdey, ya Allah Taalaa unn kay liye koi aur raasta nikalay
Tum mein say jo do fard aisa kaam ker len unhen ezza do agar woh tauba aur islaah ker len to unn say mun pher lo, bey shak Allah Taalaa tauba qabool kerney wala aur reham kerney wala hai

Allah Taalaa sirf unhi logon ki tauba qabool farmata hai jo ba-waja nadani koi buraee ker guzren phir jald uss say baaz aa jayen aur tauba keren to Allah Taalaa bhi unn ki tauba qabool kerta hai, Allah Taalaa baray ilm wala hikmat wala hai

Unn ki tauba nahi jo buraiyan kertay chalay jayen yahan tak kay jab unn mein say kissi kay pass maut aajaye to keh dey kay mein ney abb tauba ki, aur unn ki tauba bhi qabool nahi jo kufur per hi marr jayen, yehi log hain jin kay liye hum ney alamnaak azab tayyar ker rakha hai

Eman walo! tumhen halal nahi kay zabardasti aurton ko virsay mein ley betho unhen uss liye rok na rakho kay jo tum ney unhen dey rakha hai, uss mein say kuch ley lo haan yeh aur baat hai kay woh koi khulli buraee aur bey hayaee keren unn kay sath achay tareeqay say bod-o-baash rakho, go tum unhen pasand kero lekin boht mumkin hai kay tum kissi cheez ko bura jano, aur Allah Taalaa uss mein boht hi bhalaee ker dey

Aur agar tum aik biwi ki jagah doosri biwi kerna hi chahao aur unn mein say kissi ko tum ney khazana ka khazana dey rakha ho, to bhi uss mein say kuch na lo kiya tum ussay na-haq aur khulla gunah hotay huye bhi ley lo gay, tum ussay kaisay ley lo gay
Halankay tum aik doosray say mill chukay ho aur unn aurton ney tum say mazboot ehad o-paymaan ley rakha hai
Aur unn aurton say nikkah na kero jin say tumharay baapon ney nikkah kiya hai magar jo guzar chuka hai, yeh bey hayaee ka kaam aur bughz ka sabab hai aur bari buri raah hai

Haram ki gaeen tum per tumhari maayen aur tumhari larkiyan aur tumhari behnen, tumhari phoopiyan aur tumhari khalaayen aur bhai ki larkiyan aur behan ki larkiyan aur tumhari woh maayen jinhon ney tumhen doodh pilaya ho aur tumhari doodh shareek behnen aur tumhari saas aur tumhari woh perwerish kerdah larkiyan jo tumhari godd mein hain, tumhari unn aurton say jin say tum dakhool ker chukay ho, haan agar tum ney unn say jamaa na kiya ho to tum per koi gunah nahi aur tumharay salbi sagay beton ki biwiyan aur tumhara do behnon ka jama kerna haan jo guzar chuka so guzar chuka, yaqeenan Allah Taalaa bakhshney wala meharban hai

Aur (haram ki gaeen) shoher wali aurten magar woh jo tumhari milkiyat mein aajayen, Allah Taalaa ney yeh ehkaam tum per farz ker diye hain, aur unn aurton kay siwa aur aurten tumharay liye halal ki gaeen kay apney maal kay mehar say tum unn say nikkah kerna chahao buray kaam say bachney kay liye na kay shehwat rani kerney kay liye, uss liye jin say tum faeedah uthao unhen unn ka muqarrar kiya hua mehar dey do, aur mehar muqarrar ho janey kay baad tum aapas ki razamandi say jo tey kerlo uss mein tum per koi gunah nahi, bey shak Allah Taalaa ilm wala hikmat wala hai

Aur tum mein say jiss kissi ko aazad musalman aurton say nikkah kerney ki poori wusat o taqat na ho to woh musalman londiyon say jin kay tum malik ho (apna nikkah ker ley) Allah tumharay aemaal ko bakhoobi jannay wala hai, tum sab aapas mein aik hi to ho, uss liye unn kay maalikon ki ijazat say unn say nikkah ker lo, aur qaeeday kay mutabiq unn kay mehar unn ko do, woh pak daman hun na kay aelaaniya bad-kaari kerney waliyan, na khufiya aashnaee kerney waliyan, pus jab yeh londiyan nikkah mein aajayen phir agar woh bey hayaee ka kaam keren to unhen aadhi saza hai uss saza say jo aazad aurton ki hai. Kaneezon say nikkah ka yeh hukum tum mein say unn logon kay liye hai jinhen gunah aur takleef ka andesha ho aur tumhara zabt kerna boht behtar hai aur Allah Taalaa bara bakhshney wala aur bari rehmat wala hai

Allah Taalaa chahata hai kay tumharay wastay khoob khol ker biyan keray aur tumhen tum say pehlay kay (nek) logon ki raah per chalaye aur tumhari tauba qabool keray, aur Allah Taalaa jannay wala hikmat wala hai
Aur Allah chahata hai kay tumhari tauba qabool keray aur jo log khuwaishaat kay pairo hain woh chahatay hain kay tum uss say boht door hatt jao
Allah chahata hai kay tum say takhfeef ker dey kyunkay insan kamzor peda kiya gaya hai

Aey eman walo! apney aapas kay maal jaeez tareeqa say mat khao, magar yeh kay tumhari aapas ki raza mandi say ho khareed khareed-o-farokht, aur apney aap ko qatal na kero yaqeenan Allah Taalaa tum per nihayat meharban hai
Aur jo shakhs yeh (farmaniyan) sirkashi aur zulm say keray ga to unqareeb hum uss ko aag mein dakhil keren gay aur yeh Allah per aasan hai
Agar tum unn baray gunahon say bachtay raho jin say tum ko mana kiya jata hai to hum tumharay chotay gunah door ker den gay aur izzat o buzrugi ki jagah dakhil keren gay

Aur uss cheez ki aarzoo na kero jiss kay baees Allah Taalaa ney tum mein say baaz ko baaz per buzrugi di hai, mardon ka uss mein say hissa hai jo unhon ney kamaya aur aurton kay liye unn mein say hissa hai jo unhon ney kamaya, aur Allah Taalaa say uss ka fazal maango, yaqeenan Allah her cheez ka jannay wala hai

Maa baap ya qarabat daar jo chor maren uss kay waris hum ney her shakhs kay muqarrar ker diye hain aur jin say tum ney apney hathon mohaeeda kiya hai unhen unn ka hissa do haqeeqatan Allah Taalaa her cheez per hazir hai

Mard aurton per haakim hain uss wajah say kay Allah Taalaa ney aik ko doosray per fazilat di hai aur uss wajah say kay mardon ney apney maal kharach kiye hain, pus nek farmanbardar aurten khawind ki adam mojoodgi mein ba hifazat elahi nigehdasht rakhney waliyan hain aur jin aurton ki na-farmani aur dimaghi ka tumhen khof ho unhen naseehat kero aur unhen alag biostaron per chor do aur unhen maar ki saza do phir agar woh tabeydaari keren to unn per koi raasta talash na kero, bey shak Allah Taalaa bari bulandi aur baraee wala hai

Agar tumhen miyan biwi kay darmiyan aapas ki unn bann ka khof ho to aik munsif mard walon mein say aur aik aurat kay ghar walon mein say muqarrar kero, agar yeh dono sulah kerana chahayen gay to Allah dono mein milaap kera dey ga, yaqeenan Allah Taalaa pooray ilm wala poori khabar wala hai

Aur Allah Taalaa ki ibadat kero aur uss kay sath kissi ko shareek na kero aur maa baap kay sath salook o ehsan kero aur rishtay daron say aur yateemon say aur miskeenon say aur qarabat daar humsaya say aur ajnabi humsaya say aur pehloo kay sathi say aur raah kay musafir say aur unn say jin kay malik tumharay hath hain, (ghulam kaneez) yaqeenan Allah Taalaa takabbur kerney walon aur shekhi khoron ko pasand nahi farmata

Jo log khud bakheeli kertay hain aur doosron ko bhi bakheeli kerney ko kehtay hain aur Allah Taalaa ney jo apna fazal unhen dey rakha hai ussay chupa letay hain hum ney unn kafiron kay liye zillat ki maar tayyar ker rakhi hai

Aur jo log apna maal logon kay dikhaway kay liye kharach kertay hain aur Allah Taalaa per aur qayamat kay din per eman nahi rakhtay aur jiss ka hum nasheen aur sathi shetan ho, woh bad-tareen sathi hai
Bhala unn ka kiya nuksan tha agar yeh Allah Taalaa per aur qayamat kay din per eman latay aur Allah Taalaa ney jo unhen dey rakha hai uss mein kharach kertay, Allah Taalaa unhen khoob jannay wala hai
Bey shak Allah Taalaa aik zarra barabar zulm nahi kerta aur agar neki ho to ussay doogni ker deta hai aur khaas apney pass say boht bara sawab deta hai
Pus kiya haal hoga jiss waqt kay her ummat mein say aik gawah hum layen gay aur aap ko unn logon per gawah bana ker layen gay
Jiss roz kafir aur rasool kay nafarman aarzoo keren gay kay kaash! unhen zamin kay sath humwaar ker diya jata aur Allah Taalaa say koi baat na chupa saken gay

Aey eman walo! jab tum nashay mein mast ho namaz kay qareeb bhi na jao, jab tak kay apni baat ko samajhney na lago aur janabat ki halat mein jab tak kay ghusul na ker lo, haan agar raah chaltay guzar janey walay ho to aur baat hai aur agar tum beemar ho ya safar mein ho ya tum mein say koi qaza-e hajat say aaya ho ya tum ney aurton say mubashirat ki ho aur tumhen pani na milay to pak mitti ka qasad kero aur apney mun aur apney hath mill lo. Bey shak Allah Taalaa moaf kerney wala, bakhshney wala hai
Kiya tum ney unhen nahi dekha? Jinhen kitab ka kuch hissa diya gaya hai, woh gumrahi khareedtay hain aur chahatay hain kay tum bhi raah say bhatak jao
Allah Taalaa tumharay dushmanon ko khoob jannay wala hai aur Allah Taalaa ka dost hona kafi hai aur Allah Taalaa ka madadgar hona bus hai

Baaz yahud kalmaat ko unn ki theek jagah say hair pher ker detay hain aur kehtay hain kay hum ney suna aur na-farmani ki aur sunn uss kay baghair kay to suna jaye aur humari riyayat ker! (lekin uss kay kehney mein) apni zaban ko paich detay hain aur deen mein taana detay hain aur agar yeh log kehtay kay hum ney suna aur hum ney farmanbardari ki aur aap suniye humen dekhiye to yeh unn kay liye boht behtar aur nihayat hi munasib tha, lekin Allah Taalaa ney unn kay kufur ki wajah say unhen laanat ki hai. Pus yeh boht hi kum eman latay hain,

Aey ahl kitab! jo kuch hum ney nazil farmaya hai jo uss ki bhi tasdeeq kerney wala hai jo tumharay pass hai, uss per eman lao uss say pehlay kay hum chehray bigar den aur unhen lota ker peeth ki taraf ker den, ya unn per laanat bhejen jaisay hum ney haftay kay din walon per laanat ki hai, aur Allah Taalaa ka kaam kiya gaya

Yaqeenan Allah Taalaa apney sath shareek kiye janey ko nahi bakshta aur uss kay siwa jissay chahaye bakhsh deta hai aur jo Allah Taalaa kay sath shareek muqarrar keray uss ney boht bara gunah aur bohtan bandha
Kiya aap ney unhen nahi dekha jo apni pakeezgi aur sataeesh khud kertay hain? Balkay)yeh Allah Taalaa jissay chahaye pakeezah kerta hai, kissi per aik dhagay kay barabar zulm na kiya jaye ga
Dekho yeh log Allah Taalaa per kiss tarah jhoot bandhtay hain aur yeh (harkat) sareeh gunah honey kay liye kafi hai

Kiya aap ney unhen nahi dekha jinhen kitab ka kuch hissa mila? Jo butt ka aur baatil mabood ka aetiqaad rakhtay hain aur kafiron kay haq mein kehtay hain kay yeh log eman walon say ziyadah raah raast per hain
Yehi woh log hain jinhen Allah Taalaa ney laanat ki hai aur jissay Allah Taalaa laanat ker dey, to uss ka koi madadgar na paye ga
Kiya unn ka koi hissa saltanat mein hai? Agar aisa ho to phir yeh kissi ko aik khajoor ki guthli kay shigaf kay barabar bhi kuch na den gay
Ya yeh logon say hasad kertay hain uss per jo Allah Taalaa ney apney fazal say unhen diya hai, pus hum ney to aal Ibrahim ko kitab aur hikmat bhi di hai aur bari saltanat bhi ata farmaee hai
Phir unn mein say baaz ney to uss kitab ko mana aur baaz uss say ruk gaye, aur jahannum ka jalana kafi hai

Jin logon ney humari aayaton say kufur kiya, unhen hum yaqeenan aag mein daal den gay jab unn ki khaalen pakk jayen gi hum unn kay siwa aur khaalen badal den gay takay woh azab chakhtay rahen, yaqeenan Allah Taalaa ghalib hikmat wala hai

Aur jo log eman laye aur shaista aemaal kiye hum unqareeb unhen unn jannaton mein ley jayen gay jin kay neechay nehren beh rahi hain, jin mein woh hamesha hamesha rahen gay, unn kay liye o haan saaf suthri biwiyan hun gi aur hum unhen ghani chaaon (aur poori rahat) mein ley jayen gay

Allah Taalaa tumhen takeedi hukum deta hai kay amanat walon ki amanaten unhen phonchao! aur jab logon ka faisla kero to adal o insaf say faisla kero! yaqeenan woh behtar cheez hai jiss ki naseehat tumhen Allah Taalaa ker raha hai. Bey shak Allah Taalaa sunta hai, dekhta hai

Aey eman walo! farmanbardari kero Allah Taalaa ki aur farmanbardari kero rasool (salla Allah alaihi wasallam) ki aur tum mein say ikhtiyar walon ki. Phir agar kissi cheez mein ikhtilaf kero to ussay lotao, Allah Taalaa ki taraf aur rasool ki taraf, agar tumhen Allah Taalaa per aur qayamat kay din per eman hai. Yeh boht behtar hai aur ba-aetbaar anjam kay boht acha hai.

Kiya aap ney unhen nahi dekha? Jin ka dawa to yeh hai kay jo kuch aap per aur jo kuch aap say pehlay utara gaya hai uss per unn ka eman hai, lekin woh apney faislay ghair Allah ki taraf ley jana chahatay hain halankay unhen hukum diya gaya hai kay shetan ka inkar keren, shetan to yeh chahata hai kay unhen behka ker door daal dey
Unn say jab kabhi kaha jaye kay Allah Taalaa kay nazil kerdah kalaam ki aur rasool (salla Allah alaihi wasallam) ki taraf aao to aap dekh len gay kay yeh munafiq aap say mun pher ker rukay jatay hain

Phir kiya baat hai kay jab unn per unn kay kartoot kay baees koi museebat parti hai to phir yeh aap kay pass aaker Allah Taalaa ki qasmen khatay hain kay humara iradah to sirf bhalaee aur mail milaap hi ka tha

Yeh woh log hain kay unn kay dilon ka bhed Allah Taalaa per bakhoobi roshan hai, aap unn say chasham poshi kijiye, unhen naseehat kertay rahiye aur unhen woh baat kahiye! jo unn kay dilon mein ghar kerney wali ho

Hum ney her her rasool ko sirf ussi liye bheja kay Allah Taalaa kay hukum say uss ki farmanbardari ki jaye aur agar yeh log jab unhon ney apni janon per zulm kiya tha, teray pass aa jatay aur Allah Taalaa say istaghfaar kertay aur rasool bhi unn kay liye istaghfaar kertay, to yaqeenan yeh log Allah Taalaa ko moaf kerney wala meharban patay

So qasam hai teray perwerdigar ki! yeh momin nahi ho saktay, jab tak kay tamam aapas kay ikhtilaf mein aap ko haakim na maan len, phir jo faislay aap unn mein ker den unn say apney dil mein aur kissi tarah ki tangi aur khushi na payen aur farmanbardari kay sath qabool ker len

Aur agar hum unn per yeh farz ker detay kay apni janon ko qatal ker dalo! ya apney gharon say nikal jao! to ussay unn mein say boht hi kum log baja latay aur agar yeh o hi keren jiss ki unhen naseehat ki jati hai to yaqeenan yehi unn kay liye behtar aur boht ziyadah mazbooti wala hai
Aur tab to unhen hum apney pass say bara sawab den
Aur yaqeenan unhen raah raast dikha den

Aur jo bhi Allah Taalaa ki aur rasool (salla Allah alaihi wasallam) ki farmanbardari keray, woh unn logon kay sath hoga jin per Allah Taalaa ney inam kiya hai, jaisay nabi aur siddique aur shaheed aur nek log, yeh behtareen rafiq hain
Yeh fazal Allah Taalaa ki taraf say hai aur kafi hai Allah Taalaa jannay wala hai
Aey musalmano! apney bachao ka saman ley lo phir giroh giroh bann ker kooch kero ya sab kay sab ikatthay ho ker nikal kharay ho

Aur yaqeenan tum mein baaz woh bhi hain jo pus o paish kertay hain, phir agar tumhen koi nuksan hota hai to woh kehtay hain kay Allah Taalaa ney mujh per bara fazal kiya kay mein unn kay sath mojood na tha
Aur agar tumhen Allah Taalaa ka koi fazal mill jaye to uss tarah kay goya tum mein unn mein dosti thi hi nahi, kehtay hain kaash! mein bhi unn kay humrah hota to bari kaamyabi ko phonchta

Pus jo log duniya ki zindagi ko aakhirat kay badlay baich chukay hain, unhen Allah Taalaa ki raah mein jihad kerna chahaiye aur jo shakhs Allah Taalaa ki raah mein jihad kertay huye shahdat paa ley ya ghalib aajaye, yaqeenan hum ussay boht bara sawab inayat farmaeen gay

Bhala kiya wajah hai kay tum Allah ki raah mein aur unn tawan mardon, aurton aur nannhay nannhay bachon kay chutkaray kay liye jihad na kero? Jo yun duayen maang rahey hain kay aey humaray perwerdigar! unn zalimon ki basti say humen nijat dey aur humaray liye khud apney pass say himayati muqarrar ker dey aur humaray liye khaas apney pass say madadgar bana

Jo log eman laye hain woh to Allah Taalaa ki raah mein jihad kertay hain aur jin logon ney kufur kiya hai, woh Allah Taalaa kay siwa auron ki raah mein lartay hain pus tum shetan kay doston say jang kero! yaqeen mano kay shetani heela (bilkul boda aur) sakht kamzor hai

Kiya tum ney unhen nahi dekha jinhen hukum kiya gaya tha kay apney hathon ko rokay rakho aur namazen parhtay raho aur zakat ada kertay raho. Phir jab unhen jihad ka hukum diya gaya to ussi waqt unn ki aik jamat logon say uss qadar darney lagi jaisay Allah Taalaa ka darr ho, balkay)yeh uss say bhi ziyadah, aur kehney lagay aey humaray rab! tu ney hum per jihad kiyon farz ker diya? Kiyon humen thori si zindagi aur na jeenay di? Aap keh dijiye kay duniya ki mandi to boht hi kum hai aur perhezgaron kay liye to aakhirat hi behtar hai aur tum per aik dhagay kay barabar bhi sitam rawa na rakha jaye ga

Tum jahan kahen bhi ho maut tumhen pakray gi, go tum mazboot qilon mein ho, aur agar unhen koi bhalaee milti hai to kehtay hain kay yeh Allah Taalaa ki taraf say hai aur agar koi buraee phonchti hai to keh uthtay hain kay yeh teri taraf say hai. Unhen keh do kay yeh sab kuch Allah Taalaa ki taraf say hai. Unhen kiya hogaya hai kay koi baat samajhney kay bhi qareeb nahi

Tujhay jo bhalaee milti hai woh Allah Taalaa ki taraf say hai aur jo buraee phonchti hai woh teray apney nafs ki taraf say hai, hum ney tujhay tamam logon ko paygham phonchaney wala bana ker bheja hai aur Allah Taalaa gawah kafi hai
Uss rasool (salla Allah alaihi wasallam) ki jo ita’at keray ussi ney Allah Taalaa ki farmanbardari ki aur jo mun pher ley to hum ney aap ko kuch unn per nigehbaan bana ker nahi bheja

Yeh kehtay to hain kay ita’at hai, phir jab aap kay pass say uth ker bahir nikaltay hain to unn mein ki aik jamat, jo baat aap ney ya uss ney kahi hai uss kay khilaf raaton ko mashwaray kerti hai, unn ki raaton ki baat cheet Allah likh raha hai, to aap unn say mun pher len aur Allah per bharosa rakhen, Allah Taalaa kafi kaarsaaz hai
Kiya yeh log Quran mein ghor nahi kertay? Agar yeh Allah Taalaa kay siwa kissi aur ki taraf say hota to yaqeenan uss mein boht kuch ikhtilaf patay

Jahan unhen koi khabar aman ki ya khof ki mili unhon ney ussay mashoor kerna shuroo ker diya, halankay agar yeh log ussay rasool (salla Allah alaihi wasallam) kay aur apney mein say aisi baaton ki teh tak phonchney walon kay hawalay ker detay, to uss ki haqeeqat woh log maloom ker letay jo nateeja akhaz kertay hain aur agar Allah Taalaa ka fazal aur uss ki rehmat tum per na hoti to maddoday chand kay alawa tum sab shetan kay pairokaar bann jatay

To Allah Taalaa ki raah mein jihad kerta reh, tujhay sirf teri zaat ki nisbat hukum diya jata hai, haan eman walon ko raghbat dilata reh, boht mumkin hai kay Allah Taalaa kafiron ki jang ko rok dey aur Allah Taalaa sakht qooat wala hai aur saza deney mein bhi sakht hai

Jo shakhs kissi neki ya bhalay kaam ki sifarish keray, ussay bhi uss ka kuch hissa milay ga aur jo buraee aur badi ki sifarish keray uss kay liye bhi uss mein say aik hissa hai, aur Allah Taalaa her cheez per qudrat rakhney wala hai
Aur jab tumhen salam kiya jaye to tum uss say acha jawab do ya unhi alfaaz ko lota do, bey shuba)yeh Allah Taalaa her cheez ka hisab lenay wala hai

Allah woh hai jiss kay siwa koi mabood (bar-haq) nahi woh tum sab ko yaqeenan qayamat kay din jama keray ga, jiss kay (aaney) mein koi shak nahi, Allah Taalaa say ziyadah sachi baat wala aur kaun hoga

Tumhen kiya hogaya hai? Kay munafiqon kay baray mein do giroh ho rahey ho? Unhen to unn kay aemaal ki wajah say Allah Taalaa ney ondha ker diya hai. Abb kiya tum yeh mansoobay bandh rahey ho kay Allah Taalaa kay gumrah kiye huwon ko tum raah raast per khara kero, jissay Allah Taalaa raah bhala dey to hergiz uss kay liye koi raah na paye ga

Unn ki to chahat hai kay jiss tarah kay kafir woh hain to bhi unn ki tarah kufur kerney lago aur phir sab yaksan ho jao, pus jab tak yeh islam ki khatir watan na choren unn mein say kissi ko haqeeqi dost na banao, phir agar yeh mun pher len to unhen pakro aur qatal kero jahan bhi yeh hath lag jayen, khabardaar! unn mein say kissi ko apna rafiq aur madadgar na samajh bethna

Siwaye unn kay jo uss qom say talluq rakhtay hun jin say tumhara mohaeeda ho chuka hai ya jo tumharay pass uss halat mein aayen kay tum say jang kerney say bhi tang dil hain aur apni qom say bhi jang kerney say tang dil hain aur agar Allah Taalaa chahata to unhen tum per musallat ker deta aur woh tum say yaqeenan jang kertay, pus agar yeh log tum say kinara kashi ikhtiyar ker len aur tum say laraee na keren aur tumhari janib sulah ka paygham dalen, to Allah Taalaa ney tumharay liye unn per koi raah laraee ki nahi ki

Tum kuch aur logon ko aisa bhi pao gay jin ki (zahir) chahat hai kay tum say bhi aman mein rahen. Aur apni qom say bhi aman mein rahen (lekin) jab kabhi fitna angezi ki taraf lotaye jatay hain to ondhay mun uss mein daal diye jatay hain, pus agar yeh log tum say kinara kashi na keren aur tum say sulah ka silsila jannbaee na keren aur apney hath na rok len, to unhen pakro aur maar dalo jahan kahen bhi paalo! yehi woh hain jin per hum ney tumhen zahir hujjat inayat farmaee hai

Kissi momin ko doosray momin ka qatal ker dena zaiba nahi magar ghalati say ho jaye (to aur baat hai), jo shakhs kissi musalman ko bula qasad maar dalay, uss per aik musalman ghulam ki gardan aazad kerna aur maqtool kay azizon ko khoon baha phonchana hai. Haan yeh aur baat hai kay woh log bator sadqa moaf ker den aur agar maqtool tumhari dushman qom ka ho aur ho woh musalman, to sirf aik momin ghulam ki gardan aazad kerni lazmi hai. Aur agar maqtool uss qom say ho kay tum mein aur unn mein ehad o ehad-o-paymaan hai to khoon baha lazim hai, jo uss kay kunbay walon ko phonchaya jaye aur aik musalman ghulam ka aazad kerna bhi (zaroori hai), pus jo na paye uss kay zimmay do maheeney kay lagataar rozay hain, Allah Taalaa say bakshwaney kay liye aur Allah Taalaa bakhoobi jannay wala aur hikmat wala hai

Aur jo koi kissi momin ko qasadan qatal ker dalay, uss ki saza dozakh hai jiss mein woh hamesha rahey ga, uss per Allah Taalaa ka ghazab hai, ussay Allah Taalaa ney laanat ki hai aur uss kay liye bara azab tayyar rakha hai

Aey eman walo! jab tum Allah ki raah mein jaa rahey ho to tehqeeq ker liya kero aur jo tum say salam alaik keray to ussay yeh na keh do kay to eman wala nahi. Tum dunyawi zindagi kay asbaab ki talash mein ho to Allah Taalaa kay pass boht si ghanimaten hain. Pehlay tum bhi aisay hi thay, phir Allah Taalaa ney tum per ehsan kiya lehaza tum zaroor tehqeeq tehqeeq-o-tafteesh ker liya kero, bey shak Allah Taalaa tumharay aemaal say ba-khabar hai

Apni janon aur maalon say Allah ki raah mein jihad kerney walay momin aur baghair uzur kay beth rehney walay momin barabar nahi, apney maalon aur apni janon say jihad kerney walon ko beth rehney walon per Allah Taalaa ney darjon mein boht fazilat dey rakhi hai aur yun to Allah Taalaa ney her aik ko khoobi aur achai ka wada diya hai lekin mujahideen ko beth rehney walon per boht baray ajar ki fazilat dey rakhi hai
Apni taraf say martabay ki bhi aur bakhsish ki bhi aur rehmat ki bhi aur Allah Taalaa bakhsish kerney wala aur reham kerney wala hai

Jo log apni janon per zulm kerney walay hain jab farishtay unn ki rooh qabz kertay hain to poochtay hain, tum kiss haal mein thay? Yeh jawab detay hain kay hum apni jagah kamzor aur maghloob thay. Farishtay kehtay hain kiya Allah Taalaa ki zamin kushadah na thi kay tum hijrat ker jatay? Yehi log hain jin ka thikana dozakh hai aur woh phonchney ki buri jagah hai
Magar jo mard aurten aur bachay bey bus hain jinhen na to kissi chara kaar ki taqat aur na kissi raastay ka ilm hai
Boht mumkin hai kay Allah Taalaa unn say darguzar keray, Allah Taalaa darguzar kerney wala aur moaf farmaney wala hai

Jo koi Allah ki raah mein watan ko choray ga, woh zamin mein boht si qayam ki jagahen bhi paye ga aur kushadgi bhi, aur jo koi apney ghar say Allah Taalaa aur uss kay rasool (salla Allah alaihi wasallam) ki taraf nikal khara hua, phir ussay maut ney aa pakra to bhi yaqeenan uss ka ajar Allah Taalaa kay zimmay sabit ho gaya, aur Allah Taalaa bara bakhshney wala meharban hai
Jab tum safar mein jaa rahey ho to tum per namazon kay qasar kerney mein koi gunah nahi, agar tumhen darr ho kay kafir tumhen satayen gay, yaqeenan kafir tumharay khulay dushman hain

Jab tum unn mein ho aur unn kay liye namaz khari kero to chahaiye kay unn ki aik jamat tumharay sath apney hathyaar liye khari ho, phir jab yeh sajdah ker chuken to yeh hatt ker tumharay peechay aajayen aur woh doosri jamat jiss ney namaz nahi parhi woh aajaye aur teray sath namaz ada keray aur apna bachao aur apney hathyaar liye rahey, kafir chahatay hain kay kissi tarah tum apney hathyaaron aur apney saman say bey khabar ho jao to woh tum per achanak dhaawa bol den, haan apney hathyaar utaar rakhney mein uss waqt tum per koi gunah nahi jab kay tumhen takleef ho ya ba-waja barish kay ya ba-sabab beemar ho janey kay aur apney bachao ki cheezen sath liye raho, yaqeenan Allah Taalaa ney munkiron kay liye zillat ki maar tayyar ker rakhi hai
Phir jab tum namaz ada ker chuko to uthtay bethtay aur letay Allah Taalaa ka zikar kertay raho aur jab itminan pao to namaz qaeem kero! yaqeenan namaz mominon per muqarrara waqton per farz hai

Unn logon ka peecha kerney say haaray dil ho ker beth na raho! agar tumhen bey aarami hoti hai to unhen bhi tumhari tarah bey aarami hoti hai aur tum Allah Taalaa say woh umeeden rakhtay ho, jo umeeden unhen nahi, aur Allah Taalaa dana aur hakeem hai

Yaqeenan hum ney tumhari taraf haq kay sath apni kitab nazil farmaee hai takay tum logon mein uss cheez kay mutabiq faisla kero jiss say Allah ney tum ko shanasa kiya hai aur khayanat kerney walon kay himayati na bano
Aur Allah Taalaa say bakhsish maango! bey shak Allah Taalaa bakhsish kerney wala, meharbani kerney wala hai
Aur unn ki taraf say jhagra na kero jo khud apni hi khayanat kertay hain, yaqeenan dagha baaz gunehgar Allah Taalaa ko acha nahi lagta

Woh logon say to chup jatay hain, (lekin) Allah Taalaa say nahi chup saktay, woh raaton kay waqt jab kay Allah ki napasandeedah baaton kay khufiya mashwaray kertay hain uss waqt bhi Allah unn kay pass hota hai, unn kay tamam aemaal ko woh gheray huye hai

Haan to yeh ho tum log kay duniya mein tum ney unn ki himayat ki lekin Allah Taalaa kay samney qayamat kay din unn ki himayat kaun keray ga? Aur woh kaun hai jo unn ka wakeel bann ker khara ho sakay ga?
Jo shakhs koi buraee keray ya apni jaan per zulm keray phir Allah say istaghfaar keray to woh Allah ko bakhshney wala, meharbani kerney wala paye ga
Aur jo gunah kerta hai uss ka bojh ussi per hai aur Allah bakhoobi jannay wala aur poori hikmat wala hai
Aur jo shakhs koi gunah ya khata ker kay kissi bey gunah kay zimmay thop dey, uss ney boht bara bohtan uthaya aur khulla gunah kiya

Agar Allah Taalaa ka fazal o reham tujh per na hota to unn ki aik jamat ney to tujhay behkaney ka qasad ker hi liya tha, magar dar-asal yeh apney aap ko hi gumrah kertay hain, yeh tera kuch nahi bigar saktay, Allah Taalaa ney tujh per kitab o hikmat utari hai aur tujhay woh sikhaya hai jissay to nahi janta tha aur Allah Taalaa ka tujh per bara bhari fazal hai

Unn kay aksar khufiya mashwaron mein koi khair nahi, haan! bhalaee uss kay mashwaray mein hai jo kheyraat ka ya nek baat ka ya logon mein sulah keraney ka hukum keray aur jo shakhs sirf Allah Taalaa ki razamandi hasil kerney kay iraday say yeh kaam keray ussay hum yaqeenan boht bara sawab den gay

Jo shakhs bawajood raah hidayat kay wazeh ho janey kay bhi rasool (salla Allah alaihi wasallam) ka khilaf keray aur tamam mominon ki raah chor ker chalay, hum ussay udhar hi mutawajha ker den gay jidhar woh khud mutawajha ho aur dozakh mein daal den gay, woh phonchney ki boht hi buri jagah hai

Ussay Allah Taalaa qata’an na bakhshay ga kay uss kay sath shirk muqarrar kiya jaye, haan shirk kay alawa gunah jiss kay chahaye moaf farma deta hai aur Allah kay sath shareek kerney wala boht door ki gumrahi mein jaa para
Yeh to Allah Taalaa ko chor ker sirf aurton ko pukartay hain aur dar-asal yeh sirf sirkash shetan ko poojtay hain
Jissay Allah ney laanat ki hai aur uss ney baira uthaya hai kay teray bandon mein say mein muqarrar shuda hissa ley ker rahon ga

Aur unhen raah say behkata rahon ga aur baatil umeeden dilata rahon ga aur unhen sikhaon ga kay janwaron ki kaan cheer den, aur unn say kahon ga kay Allah Taalaa ki banaee hui soorat ko bigar den, suno! jo shakhs Allah ko chor shetan ko apna rafiq banaye ga woh sareeh nuksan mein doobay ga
Woh unn say zabani waday kerta rahey ga, aur sabz baagh dikhata rahey ga, (magar yaad rakho!) shetan kay jo waday unn say hain woh sirasir fareb kaariyan hain
Yeh woh log hain jin ki jagah jahannum hai, jahan say unhen chutkara na milay ga

Aur jo eman layen aur bhalay kaam keren hum unhen unn jannaton mein ley jayen gay jin kay neechay chashmay jari hain, jahan yeh abad-al-abad rahen gay, yeh hai Allah ka wada jo sirasir sacha hai aur kaun hai jo apni baat mein Allah say ziyadah sacha ho?

Haqeeqat haal na to tumhari aarzoo kay mutabiq hai aur na ahl kitab ki umeedon per moqoof hai, jo bura keray ga uss ki saza paye ga aur kissi ko na paye ga jo uss ki himayat o madad, Allah kay pass ker sakay
Jo eman wala ho mard ho ya aurat aur woh nek aemaal keray, yaqeenan aisay log jannat mein jayen gay aur khajoor ki guthli kay shigaf barabar bhi unn ka haq na maara jaye ga

Ba-aetbaar deen kay uss say acha kaun hai? Jo apney ko Allah kay tabey ker dey aur ho bhi neko kaar, sath hi yaksui walay Ibrahim kay deen ki pairwee ker raha ho aur Ibrahim (alaihi as-salam) ko Allah Taalaa ney apna dost bana liya hai
Aasmano aur zamin mein jo kuch hai sab Allah hi ka hai aur Allah Taalaa her cheez ko gherney wala hai

Aap say aurton kay baray mein hukum daryaft kertay hain, aap keh dijiye! kay khud Allah unn kay baray mein hukum dey raha hai aur Quran ki woh aayaten jo tum per unn yateem larkiyon kay baray mein parhi jati hain jinhen unn ka muqarrar haq tum nahi detay aur unhen apney nikkah mein laney ki raghbat rakhtay ho aur kamzor bachon kay baray mein aur uss baray mein kay yateemon ki guzari insaf kay sath kero. Tum jo nek kaam kero, bey shuba)yeh Allah ussay poori tarah jannay wala hai

Agar kissi aurat ko apney shoher ki bad dimaghi aur bey perwahi ka khof ho to dono aapas mein jo sulah ker len uss mein kissi per koi gunah nahi. Sulah boht behtar cheez hai, tama her her nafs mein shamil ker di gaee hai. Agar tum acha salook kero aur perhezgari kero to tum jo ker rahey ho uss per Allah Taalaa poori tarah khabardaar hai

Tum say yeh to kabhi na ho sakay ga kay apni tamam biwiyon mein her tarah adal kero, go tum uss ki kitni hi khuwahish o koshish ker lo, uss liye bilkul hi aik ki taraf maeel ho ker doosri ko udhar latakti hui na choro aur agar tum islaah kero aur taqwa ikhtiyar kero to, bey shak Allah Taalaa bari maghfirat aur rehmat wala hai
Aur agar miyan biwi juda ho jayen to Allah Taalaa apni wusat say her aik ko bey niaz ker dey ga, Allah Taalaa wusat wala hikmat wala hai

Zamin aur aasmano ki her her cheez Allah Taalaa hi ki milkiyat mein hai aur waqaee hum ney unn logon ko jo tum say pehlay kitab diye gaye thay aur tum ko bhi yehi hukum kiya hai kay Allah say dartay raho aur agar tum kufur kero to yaad rakho kay Allah kay liye hai jo kuch aasmano mein hai aur jo kuch zamin mein hai aur Allah boht bey niaz aur tareef kiya gaya hai
Allah kay ikhtiyar mein hain aasmano ki sab cheezen aur zamin ki bhi aur Allah kaar saaz kafi hai
Agar ussay manzoor ho to aey logo! woh tum sab ko ley jaye aur doosron ko ley aaye, Allah Taalaa uss per poori qudrat rakhney wala hai
Jo shakhs duniya ka sawab chahata ho to (yaad rakho kay) Allah Taalaa kay pass to duniya aur aakhirat (dono) ka sawab mojood hai aur Allah Taalaa boht sunnay wala aur khoob dekhney wala hai

Aey eman walo! adal o insaf per mazbooti say jamm janey walay aur khushnoodi mola kay liye sachi gawahi denay walay bann jao, go woh khud tumharay apney khilaf ho ya apney maa baap kay ya rishtay daar azizon kay, woh shakhs agar amir ho to aur faqir ho to dono kay sath Allah ko ziyadah talluq hai, uss liye tum khuwahish nafs kay peechay parr ker insaf na chor dena aur agar tum ney kajj biyani ya pehloo tahi ki to jaan lo kay jo kuch tum kero gay Allah Taalaa uss say poori tarah ba-khabar hai

Aey eman walo! Allah Taalaa per, uss kay rasool (salla Allah alaihi wasallam) per aur uss kitab per jo uss ney apney rasool (salla Allah alaihi wasallam) per utari hai aur unn kitabon per jo uss say pehlay uss ney nazil farmaee hain, eman lao! jo shakhs Allah Taalaa say aur uss kay farishton say aur uss ki kitabon say aur uss kay rasoolon say aur qayamat kay din say kufur keray woh to boht bari door ki gumrahi mein jaa para
Jin logon ney eman qabool ker kay phir kufur kiya, phir eman ker phir kufur kiya, phir apney kufur mein barh gaye, Allah Taalaa yaqeenan unhen na bakhshay ga aur na unhen raah hidayat samjhaye ga
Munafiqon ko uss amar ki khabar phoncha do kay unn kay liye dard-naak azab yaqeeni hai

Jin ki yeh halat hai kay musalmanon ko chor ker kafiron ko dost banatay phirtay hain, kiya unn kay pass izzat ki talash mein jatay hain? (to yaad rakhen kay) izzat to sari ki sari Allah Taalaa kay qabzay mein hai

Aur Allah Taalaa tumharay pass apni kitab mein yeh hukum utaar chuka hai kay tum jab kissi majlis walon ko Allah Taalaa ki aayaton kay sath kufur kertay aur mazaq uratay huye suno to uss majmay mein unn kay sath na betho! jab tak kay woh uss kay alawa aur baaten na kerney lagen, (werna) tum bhi uss waqt unhi jaisay ho, yaqeenan Allah Taalaa tamam kafiron aur sab munafiqon ko jahannum mein jama kerney wala hai

Yeh log tumharay anjam kaar ka intizar kertay rehtay hain phir agar tumhen Allah fatah dey to yeh kehtay hain kay kiya hum tumharay sathi nahi aur agar kafiron ko thora sa ghalba mill jaye to (unn say) kehtay hain kay hum tum per ghalib na aaney lagay thay aur kiya hum ney tumhen musalmanon kay hathon say na bachaya tha? Pus qayamat mein khud Allah Taalaa tumharay darmiyan faisla keray ga aur Allah Taalaa kafiron ko eman walon per hergiz raah na dey ga

Bey shak munafiq Allah say baziyan ker rahey hain aur woh unhen uss chaalbazi ka badla denay wala hai aur jab namaz ko kharay hotay hain to bari kaahili ki halat mein kharay hotay hain sirf logon ko dikhatay hain, aur yaad elahi to yun hi si baraye naam kertay hain
Woh darmiyan mein hi moalliq dagmaga rahey hain, na pooray unn ki taraf na sahih tor per unn ki taraf aur jissay Allah Taalaa gumrahi mein daal dey to to uss kay liye koi raah na paye ga
Aey eman walo! mominon ko chor ker kafiron ko dost na banao, kiya tum yeh chahatay ho kay apney upper Allah Taalaa ki saaf hujjat qaeem ker lo
Munafiq to yaqeenan jahannum kay sab say neechay kay tabqay mein jayen gay, na-mumkin hai kay to unn ka koi madadgar paley

Haan jo tauba ker len aur islaah ker len aur Allah Taalaa per kamil yaqeen rakhen aur khalis Allah hi kay liye deendari keren to yeh log mominon kay sath hain, Allah Taalaa mominon ko boht bara ajar dey ga
Allah Taalaa tumhen saza dey ker kiya keray ga? Agar tum shukar guzari kertay raho aur ba-emaan raho, Allah Taalaa boht qadar kerney wala aur poora ilm rakhney wala hai
Buraee kay sath awaz buland kerney ko Allah Taalaa pasand nahi farmata magar mazloom ki ijazat hai aur Allah Taalaa khoob sunta janta hai
Agar tum kissi neki ko aelaaniya kero ya posheedah, ya kissi buraee say darguzar kero, pus yaqeenan Allah Taalaa poori moafi kerney wala aur poori qudrat wala hai

Jo log Allah kay sath aur uss kay payghumbaron kay sath kufur kertay hain aur jo log yeh chahatay hain kay Allah aur uss kay rasoolon kay darmiyan farq rakhen aur jo log kehtay hain kay baaz nabiyon per to humara eman hai aur baaz per nahi aur chahatay hain kay uss kay aur uss kay been been koi raah nikalen
Yaqeen mano kay yeh sab log asli kafir hain, aur kafiron kay liye hum ney ehanat aamez saza tayyar ker rakhi hai

Aur jo log Allah per aur uss kay tamam payghumbaron per eman latay hain aur unn mein say kissi mein farq nahi kertay, yeh hain jinhen Allah unn ko poora sawab dey ga aur Allah bari maghfirat wala bari rehmat wala hai

Aap say yeh ahl kitab darkhuast kertay hain kay aap unn kay pass koi aasmani kitab layen, hazrat Musa (alaihi as-salam) say to unhon ney uss say boht bari darkhuast ki thi kay humen khullam khulla Allah Taalaa ko dikha dey, pus unn kay uss zulm kay baees unn per karakay ki bijli aa pari phir bawajood unn kay pass boht daleelen phonch chuki thin unhon ney bachray ko apna mabood bana liya, lekin hum ney yeh bhi moaf farma diya aur hum ney Musa ko khulla ghalba (aur sareeh daleel) inayat farmaee

Aur unn ka qol lenay kay liye hum ney unn kay saron per tor pahar laa khara kerdiya aur unhen hukum diya kay sajdah kertay huye darwazay mein jao aur yeh bhi farmaya kay haftay kay din mein tajawuz na kerna aur hum ney unn say sakht say sakht qol o qarar liye

(yeh saza thi) ba sabab unn ki ehad shikni kay aur ehkaam elahi kay sath kufur kerney kay aur Allah kay nabiyon ko na-haq qatal ker dalney kay, aur uss sabab say kay yun kehtay hain kay humaray dilon per ghilaaf hai. Halankay dar-asal unn kay kufur ki wajah say unn kay dilon per Allah Taalaa ney mehar laga di hai, uss liye yeh qadar qaleel hi eman latay hain
Aur unn kay kufur kay baees aur Maryam per boht bara bohtan bandhney kay baees

Aur yun kehney kay baees kay hum ney Allah kay rasool maseeh Isa bann Maryam ko qatal ker diya halankay na to unhon ney ussay qatal kiya na sooli per charhaya balkay)yeh unn kay liye unn (Isa) ka shabeeh bana diya gaya tha. Yaqeen jano kay hazrat Isa (alaihi as-salam) kay baray mein ikhtilaf kerney walay unn kay baray mein shak mein hain, unhen uss ka koi yaqeen nahi ba-juz takhmeeni baaton per amal kerney kay itna yaqeeni hai kay unhon ney unhen qatal nahi kiya
Balkay)yeh Allah Taalaa ney unhen apni taraf utha liya aur Allah bara zabardast aur poori hikmaton wala hai
Ahl kitab mein aik bhi aisa na bachay ga jo hazrat Isa (alaihi as-salam) ki maut say pehlay unn per eman na chukay aur qayamat kay din aap unn per gawah hun gay
Jo nafees cheezen unn kay liye halal ki gaee thin woh hum ney unn per haram ker den unn kay zulm kay baees aur Allah Taalaa ki raah say aksar logon ko rokney kay baees
Aur sood jiss say mana kiye gaye thay ussay lenay kay baees aur logon ka maal na-haq maar khaney kay baees aur unn mein jo kuffaar hain hum ney unn kay liye alamnaak azab mohiyya ker rakha hai

Lekin unn mein say jo kamil aur mazboot ilm walay hain aur eman walay hain jo uss per eman latay hain jo aap ki taraf utara gaya aur jo aap say pehlay utara gaya aur namazon ko qaeem rakhney walay hain aur zakat kay ada kerney walay hain aur Allah per aur qayamat kay din per eman rakhney walay hain yeh hain jinhen hum boht baray ajar ata farmaeen gay

Yaqeenan hum ney aap ki taraf ussi tarah wahee ki hai jaisay kay Nooh (alaihi as-salam) aur unn kay baad walay nabiyon ki taraf ki, aur hum ney wahee ki Ibrahim aur Ismail aur Ishaq aur Yaqoob aur unn ki aulad per aur Isa aur Ayyub aur Yunus aur Haroon aur Sulaiman ki taraf. Aur hum ney Dawood (alaihi as-salam) ko Zaboor ata farmaee
Aur aap say pehlay kay boht say rasoolon kay waqiyaat hum ney aap say biyan kiye hain aur boht say rasoolon kay nahi bhi kiye aur Musa (alaihi as-salam) say Allah Taalaa ney saaf tor per kalaam kiya

Hum ney unhen rasool banaya hai, khushkhabriyan sunaney walay aur aagah kerney walay takay logon ki koi hujjat aur ilzam rasoolon kay bhejney kay baad Allah Taalaa per reh na jaye. Allah Taalaa bara ghalib aur bara ba-hikmat hai
Jo kuch aap ki taraf utara hai uss ki babat khud Allah Taalaa gawahi deta hai kay ussay apney ilm say utara hai aur farishtay bhi gawahi detay hain aur Allah Taalaa bator gawah kafi hai
Jin logon ney kufur kiya aur Allah Taalaa ki raah say auron ko roka woh yaqeenan gumrahi mein door nikal gaye
Jin logon ney kufur kiya aur zulm kiya, unhen Allah Taalaa hergiz hergiz na bakhshay ga aur na unhen koi raah dikhaye ga
Ba-juz jahannum ki raah kay jiss mein woh hamesha hamesha paray rahen gay, aur yeh Allah Taalaa per bilkul aasan hai

Aey logo! tumharay pass tumharay rab ki taraf haq ley ker rasool aagaya hai, pus tum eman lao takay tumharay liye behtri ho aur agar tum kafir hogaye to Allah hi ki hai her woh cheez jo aasmano aur zamin mein hai, aur Allah dana hai hikmat wala hai

Aey ahl kitab! apney deen kay baray mein hadd say na guzar jao aur Allah per ba-juz haq kay aur kuch na kaho, maseeh Isa bann Maryam (alaihi as-salam) to sirf Allah Taalaa kay rasool aur uss kay kalma (kun say peda shuda) hain, jissay Maryam (alaiha as-salam) ki taraf daal diya tha aur uss kay pass ki rooh hain uss liye tum Allah ko aur uss kay sab rasoolon ko mano aur na kaho kay Allah teen hain, uss say baaz aajao kay tumharay liye behtri hai, Allah ibadat kay laeeq to sirf aik hi hai aur woh uss say pak hai kay uss ki aulad ho, ussi kay liye hai jo kuch aasmano mein hai aur jo kuch zamin mein hai. Aur Allah kafi hai kaam bananey wala

Maseeh (alaihi as-salam) ko Allah ka bandah honey mein koi nang-o-aar o aar ya takabbur o inkar hergiz ho hi nahi sakta aur na muqarrab farishton ko, uss ki bandagi say jo bhi dil churaye aur takabbur o inkar keray, Allah Taalaa unn sab ko ikattha apni taraf jama keray ga

Pus jo log eman laye hain aur shaista aemaal kiye hain unn ko unn ka poora poora sawab inayat farmaye ga aur apney fazal say unhen aur ziyadah dey ga aur jin logon ney nang-o-aar o aar aur sirkashi aur inkar kiya, unhen alamnaak azab dey ga aur woh apney liye siwaye Allah kay koi himayati, aur imdad kerney wala na payen gay
Aey logo! tumharay pass tumharay rab ki taraf say sanad aur daleel phonchi aur hum ney tumhari janib wazeh aur saaf noor utaar diya hai
Pus jo log Allah Taalaa per eman laye aur ussay mazboot pakar liya, unhen to woh unqareeb apni rehmat aur fazal mein ley ley ga aur unhen apni taraf ki raah raast dikha dey ga

Aap say fatwa poochtay hain, aap keh dijiye kay Allah Taalaa (khud) tumhen kalala kay baray mein fatwa deta hai. Agar koi shakhs marr jaye jiss ki aulad na ho aur aik behan ho to uss kay liye choray huye maal ka aadha hissa hai aur woh bhai uss behan ka waris hoga agar uss kay aulad na ho. Pus agar behnen do hun to unhen kul choray huye ka do tehaee milay ga. Aur agar kaee shakhs uss naatay kay hain mard bhi aur aurten bhi to mard kay liye hissa hai misil do aurton kay, Allah Taalaa tumharay liye biyan farma raha hai kay aisa na ho kay tum behak jao aur Allah Taalaa her cheez say waqif hai
